name: rough_idle
description: Use when the idle is rough, hunting, too high or too low, or the engine shakes at standstill: misfires, trims, idle data and codes.
instructions: Call read_dtcs, then read_live {"pids":["010C","0105","0104","0111"],"seconds":10} at a warm idle and watch how steady rpm and load are.
On a petrol run misfire and fuel_trims when they are offered: a vacuum leak is the most common rough-idle cause.
On a diesel open extended_data (injector corrections, EGR position) and egr when they are offered; record_live gives a longer rpm trace.
When the engine is off, use ask_driver start_engine_idle before reading idle data.
interpret: Rpm swinging more than about ±100 rpm at a warm idle is hunting: a vacuum leak, the throttle body, an EGR stuck open or the injectors.
A steady but high idle on a warm engine: a coolant sensor reading cold, a vacuum leak or throttle adaptation.
On a diesel, an injector correction far from 0 (beyond about ±2 mg/stroke) points to the injector that makes the idle rough.
Rough only when cold and gone when warm: glow plugs on a diesel, a cold-start sensor or enrichment issue on a petrol.

golf-plus-2009-20tdi: The extended data has per-cylinder injector corrections (mg/stroke) and the EGR valve position; these DIDs are not yet confirmed on the car, so use them as indicative only.
